Title: [E1.S1.T1] Create React Router 7 Project
Description:
Initialize a new React Router 7 project using Vite.

**Commands:**
```bash
npm create vite@latest syphon-v1 -- --template react-ts
cd syphon-v1
npm install react-router@7 react-router-dom@7
npm run dev
```

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Project created
- [ ] npm run dev starts server on 5173
- [ ] Browser shows React + Vite page
- [ ] No console errors
